question: Does a focused crypto trend book (DON8 + EMA8, 17 perpetuals, inverse-vol entry sizing, costs and funding charged) earn positive net returns going forward?
registration_note: Registered 2026-09-26, before any day at or after the start existed. This candidate distils the evidence to date; its design is not independent of that evidence, which is why it is judged only on forward data.

design_choices_disclosed.drop_VOL8: VOL8 had the weakest result in every dataset (dev window Sharpe 0.72 with 15.6%/yr cost drag; untouched coins t 0.97; ETF history t -3.07). Chosen after seeing data.
design_choices_disclosed.universe: the 10 development coins plus the 7 untouched-holdout coins (ZEC, LTC, UNI, DOT, DASH, ETC, BCH), chosen by that holdout's mechanical rule; ENA included. Chosen after seeing data.
design_choices_disclosed.sizing: entry inverse-vol, the constants of universal-cross-asset-trend-invvol-forward-v1, fixed a priori
design_choices_disclosed.accounting: canonical v3.1 (fixed quantity plus funding); funding cost 11%/yr in the 2021 boom, so it is always charged

evidence_basis.pre_window_holdout_2020_2023: passed: Sharpe 1.76, t 3.13; 1.55 / 2.83 with funding proxy; concentrated in 2021
evidence_basis.untouched_coins_holdout: failed narrowly: Sharpe 0.76, t 1.87; DON8 t 2.05, EMA8 t 1.85
evidence_basis.etf_long_history_holdout: failed: Sharpe -0.31; these rules are crypto-specific

economics.portfolio: equal capital across the 34 strategy x coin sleeves, rebalanced daily; inter-sleeve rebalancing not charged

reporting.statistic: mean daily net return, Newey-West t (5 lags), annualized Sharpe, max drawdown, funding contribution

review_criteria_at_180_days.purpose: decide whether the evidence justifies submitting the candidate to the repository's existing paper/approval gates; this file authorizes nothing
all_required: forward max drawdown not worse than -25% (about 1.7x the 15% sleeve vol target, a guardrail)
realized funding drag within 2x of the forward-period funding estimate reported by this watch
no data-integrity or reconciliation failure in any run
review_criteria_at_180_days.note: 180 days cannot reach t=2 at plausible Sharpe (the minimum detectable Sharpe is about 2.8), so this is a sanity gate, not proof of edge. Proof needs roughly 3 or more years, or pooled independent evidence.
